# Behavior API endpoint
{: .no_toc}

Records which behavioral assay the subjects of a session performed, and in which setup.

## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/modules/behavior/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `behavior` (detail, create, update), `behaviors` (list)
- **Permissions:** inherited through `session` → `projects` (from [`project`](/api/stem/project/))
- **Deleting:** clears the link on [`epoch`](/api/stem/epoch/) records

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | UUID string **[read-only]** |
| `session` | [`session`](/api/stem/session/) id **[required]**; nestable |
| `subjects` | list of [`subject`](/api/stem/subject/) ids **[required]**; nestable |
| `setup` | [`setup`](/api/personal_attributes/setup/) id **[required]** |
| `behavioralassay` | [`behavioralassay`](/api/personal_attributes/behavioralassay/) id **[required]** |
| `notes` | string; max 500 characters; nullable |
| `order` | number; nullable. Determines the order Behaviors are listed within a Session's 'Behaviors' tab. |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('behavior', load_all=True)
records = resp['behaviors']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('behavior', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.behaviors;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "behaviors": [
        {
            "id": "<id>",
            "session": "<session-id>",
            "subjects": [
                "<subject-id>"
            ],
            "setup": "<setup-id>",
            "behavioralassay": "<behavioralassay-id>",
            "notes": "",
            "order": 1
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('behavior', data={"session": "<session-id>", "subjects": ["<subject-id>"], "setup": "<setup-id>", "behavioralassay": "<behavioralassay-id>"})
record = resp.json()['behavior']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('session', '<session-id>', 'subjects', {{'<subject-id>'}}, 'setup', '<setup-id>', 'behavioralassay', '<behavioralassay-id>'), 'behavior');
record = created.behavior;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('behavior', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['behavior']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('behavior', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.behavior;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "behavior": {
        "id": "<id>",
        "session": "<session-id>",
        "subjects": [
            "<subject-id>"
        ],
        "setup": "<setup-id>",
        "behavioralassay": "<behavioralassay-id>",
        "notes": "",
        "order": 1
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('behavior', id='<id>', data={"notes": "new value"})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'notes', 'new value'), 'behavior', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/modules/behavior/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('behavior', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'behavior');
```
